title: Implementing support for LE Audio and Auracast from KDE/Plasma's side
line: LE Audio earbuds, headsets, speakers and hearing aids now show as audio devices in the Bluetooth applet and settings, not as "Other device".
explanation: LE Audio devices usually have no classic Bluetooth class, so BluezQt derives their type from the GAP appearance, which only knew older categories (phone, computer, HID…). Earbuds, LE headsets, speakers and hearing aids came out as uncategorized and Plasma showed them as "Other device" with a generic icon; devices without an appearance also fell through because bluedevil only recognised audio by the classic A2DP profile. BluezQt now maps the Wearable Audio, Audio Sink/Source and Hearing aid appearances to Headphones/Headset/audio types (with headphone and headset icons), and bluedevil also counts the LE Audio capabilities service (PACS) as "Audio".

commits.message:
device: map LE Audio appearances to audio device types

LE Audio devices often have no Bluetooth class, so their type comes from
the GAP appearance, which only knew older categories and left earbuds,
headsets, speakers and hearing aids uncategorized. Map those as well.

BUG: 479620

applet, kcm: show LE Audio devices as audio devices

Devices that only offer LE Audio don't list the classic A2DP profile, so
uncategorized ones were shown as "Other device" in the applet and the
settings page. Also count the LE Audio capabilities service as audio.

BUG: 479620

From 25910714ee2e0b5a0545a94fd767d0864ad9dc80 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:06:17 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] device: map LE Audio appearances to audio device types

LE Audio devices often have no Bluetooth class, so their type comes from
the GAP appearance, which only knew older categories and left earbuds,
headsets, speakers and hearing aids uncategorized. Map those as well.

BUG: 479620
---
 src/utils.cpp | 11 +++++++++++
 1 file changed, 11 insertions(+)

diff --git a/src/utils.cpp b/src/utils.cpp
index d868270..ffa7f0f 100644
--- a/src/utils.cpp
+++ b/src/utils.cpp
@@ -338,6 +338,17 @@ Device::Type appearanceToType(quint16 appearance)
         return Device::AudioVideo;
     case 0x0b: // Generic Barcode Scanner
         return Device::Peripheral;
+    case 0x21: // Generic Audio Sink
+    case 0x22: // Generic Audio Source
+    case 0x29: // Generic Hearing aid
+        return Device::AudioVideo;
+    case 0x25: // Generic Wearable Audio Device
+        switch (appearance & 0x3f) {
+        case 0x02: // Headset
+            return Device::Headset;
+        default: // Earbud, Headphones, Neck Band
+            return Device::Headphones;
+        }
     case 0x0f: // Generic HID
         switch (appearance & 0x3f) {
         case 0x01: // Keyboard

media.caption: Bluetooth applet: five paired LE Audio devices all show as "Other device"
Applet with the fix: earbuds are Headphones, the headset is Headset (with their icons), the others are Audio
Bluetooth settings: every LE Audio device is "Other"
Bluetooth settings with the fix: Headphones, Headset, Multimedia, Audio

reviews.text: This patchset does not fix Bug 479620 and would erroneously close it via `BUG: 479620` in both commits. Bug 479620 requests LE Audio stereo streaming selection and Auracast broadcast listening/broadcasting UI, which the author's own notes confirm are blocked upstream in BlueZ and PipeWire/WirePlumber; these patches only add GAP appearance and PACS UUID device-type classification. In addition, the bluedevil patch papers over lowercase LE Audio UUID constants in bluez-qt with `.toUpperCase()` instead of fixing bluez-qt itself, adds no bluez-qt unit tests, and maps hearing aids to "Multimedia" in the KCM (while DeviceItem.qml lacks a case for Device.AudioVideo).
changes: Do not close Bug 479620 with this change; leave 479620 open until upstream BlueZ/PipeWire Auracast APIs are ready and submit LE Audio device-type recognition as a separate, properly scoped MR.
Fix the casing of the LE Audio service UUID constants directly in bluez-qt instead of calling `.toUpperCase()` on BluezQt.Services.PublishedAudioCapabilities in bluedevil.

Add unit tests in bluez-qt covering the new appearanceToType() LE Audio mappings, and handle Device.AudioVideo (and appropriate labeling/icons for hearing aids and LE speakers) consistently between bluedevil's applet (DeviceItem.qml) and KCM (script.js).

reviews.text: The appearance mappings are correct (0x21/0x22/0x25/0x29 categories, Headset vs other wearable-audio subcategories) and showing LE-only devices as audio instead of 'Other device' is a real improvement, backed by good before/after evidence. But the bug asks for LE Audio and Auracast support: choosing stereo LE Audio, picking which Auracast broadcast the earbuds listen to, and starting a (private) broadcast. None of that is implemented, and the fixer's own notes say the bug should stay open for Auracast. So both commits' 'BUG: 479620' would wrongly close a much larger wish. Separately, bluedevil works around BluezQt's lowercase PublishedAudioCapabilities constant with toUpperCase() even though bluez-qt is being patched anyway.
changes: Change both commits to 'CCBUG: 479620' (or file/point to a narrower bug about LE Audio devices showing as 'Other device'), since Auracast stream selection, broadcasting and the stereo LE Audio choice are not addressed.
Fix the casing of the LE Audio UUID constants in bluez-qt's services.h (they're lowercase while Device::uuids() is uppercase) and drop the .toUpperCase() workaround in bluedevil.
